ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular (form V) imperative verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَتَبَتَّلْ is in the derivative form: تَبَتَّلْ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/ت/ل   b–t–l to cut off, to separate, to stay away from others; to give up pleasures; to be celibate.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
تَبَتَّلْ tabattal and تَبْتِيلٌ tabtıl.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَبَتَّلْ tabattal [imperat. of v. V تَبَتَّلَ tabattala, intrans. with prep. إلى, v. n. تَبْتِيل tabtıl] to devote oneself entirely [to God’s service]

(73:8) وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلاً so celebrate the name of your Lord and devote yourself wholeheartedly to Him.
